blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — Democrat Xavier Becerra handily waved off an insurgent challenge from Donald Trump-backed Republican Steve Hilton on Tuesday in the race to become the governor of California, US networks said. Partial results showed Becerra, a career politican who served in the cabinet of former president Joe Biden, had a two-to-one advantage over Hilton, with almost half of the ballots counted. Becerra had run a low-key campaign in a state where Democrats heavily outnumber Republicans and where the Trump brand is almost toxic.
